purpose: Re-run the published original financial setting using the released author code, then compare all available published cells
data_generator: Unmodified released Yahoo / FinanceDataReader generators; present download vintage is archived and is not the unpublished author snapshot
seed_source: upstream/src/aggregate.py DEFAULT_SEEDS; paper does not list seed IDs
training_update_semantics: Released train_model makes one sampled batch update per epoch; actual paper epoch/update count and seed IDs are not published
k_rule: Author round(N*rho/100), never add securities to force paper N
source_preprocessing: Full-sample StandardScaler, then split; preserved to rerun the release
source_risk_constraint: norm(L*y)<=1, sum(y)=t, t>=1; no leverage/position/turnover constraints
source_inference: Soft OSCAR remains dense if source yields dense weights; do not impose a hard support repair
published_metric: Daily raw-return mean / sample standard deviation, no annualization, RF subtraction, costs or hedge

sdr.published_cardinality_matching_rule: Not released; fixed nominal k replay must be labeled as release behavior
